text: The 2021 tree-cover loss was detected by the Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset, specifically version GFC-2025-v1.13. This dataset identified a tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares within the asset during 2021. The observation was corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The Hansen GFC dataset provides annual data on stand-replacing tree-cover loss at a 30-meter resolution from 2001 to 2025.
